name: carbon-saathi
description: Carbon Saathi — your personal climate companion for India. Measure, understand, and reduce your carbon footprint with AI guidance grounded in real Indian schemes (PM Surya Ghar, PM KUSUM, EV adoption).

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @carbon-saathi/api && npm run build -w @carbon-saathi/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @carbon-saathi/api" "npm run dev -w @carbon-saathi/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @carbon-saathi/api
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @carbon-saathi/core && npm run test -w @carbon-saathi/api && npm run test -w @carbon-saathi/web
scripts.test:api: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @carbon-saathi/api
scripts.type-check: npm run build:core && npm run type-check --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
